text:
Rafael Mendes: Need to lock alert thresholds for Suggestions beta before we turn on cohort. Specifically stale estimates + “what counts as an incident” during beta. Can we align today?

Allison Grant: +1. We can’t page on every blip but we also can’t let customers optimize off week-old baselines.

Logan Wright: For context: savings estimates v1 read from metering baselines computed every 2h-ish, but jobs can slip. We’re emitting `suggestions_savings_baseline_age_hours{tenant}` + a boolean `suggestions_estimate_stale` when age > threshold.

Chloe Martin: UI currently shows “Telemetry last updated Xh ago” in the drawer. But list view only has an icon if stale (per UX spec). So if this goes stale silently, customers might still interpret the $ impact as current.

Rafael Mendes: What’s the hard cutoff for “stale” in code right now?

Logan Wright: Default is 12h. (We picked it mostly to avoid flipping stale during minor delays.) It’s a config flag in suggestions-service.

Allison Grant: 12h feels too generous for a cost optimization surface. If we say “estimated monthly savings”, and the baseline is from yesterday, it’s still “monthly” but the unit $/1M token can shift quickly.

Mei Lin: From KPI side, we’re going to compare estimated vs realized weekly. If baseline freshness is poor, the trust metric tanks. I’d rather we surface “insufficient data” than show stale.

Dylan Brooks: UX note: design was ok with stale being visible as “Last updated …” + a disclaimer, but we should avoid showing any savings number if it’s *really* stale. Otherwise Support gets dragged.

Jordan Lee: Guardrails doc currently says suppress suggestions when telemetry is missing or too sparse, but not explicitly when it’s stale. We can add “stale beyond X hours => suppress OR mark high risk”.

Rafael Mendes: Cool, but alerts. I need something actionable: when do we page, when do we ticket, when do we just log?

Allison Grant: Propose:
- Warning (ticket/Slack) if baseline age p95 > 6h for any beta tenant for >30m
- Page if baseline age p95 > 12h for >=3 beta tenants for >30m
- SEV-2 if baseline age p95 > 24h for any beta tenant (because at that point the product is misleading)

Logan Wright: Slight tweak: baseline computation is per route/model, so tenant-level “p95” can be noisy. We can compute: percent of suggestions with baseline_age_hours > threshold. That’s better.

Chloe Martin: +1. Also note: list endpoint caches for 5m. So it can look stale during recovery for a bit.

Rafael Mendes: Ok, define metrics then.

Logan Wright: We have:
- `suggestions_estimate_total{tenant}`
- `suggestions_estimate_stale_total{tenant}`
- `suggestions_baseline_age_hours_bucket{tenant}` (histogram)

We can alert on `stale_ratio = stale_total / total`.

Allison Grant: Great. Something like:

```promql
(
  sum(rate(suggestions_estimate_stale_total{env="prod", cohort="beta"}[15m]))
/
  clamp_min(sum(rate(suggestions_estimate_total{env="prod", cohort="beta"}[15m])), 1)
) > 0.10
```

Ticket when >10% for 30m, page when >30% for 30m?

Rafael Mendes: That maps better to user impact.

Mei Lin: Can we include an absolute count so one tenant with 2 suggestions doesn’t page us? E.g., require total > 100 in window.

Logan Wright: yep:

```promql
stale_ratio > 0.30
and
sum(rate(suggestions_estimate_total{env="prod", cohort="beta"}[15m])) > 100
```

Dylan Brooks: What about “all suggestions suppressed because stale”? That would show empty state and customers will complain “no suggestions”. That’s also bad.

Chloe Martin: We already have `suggestions_response_reason{reason="insufficient_freshness"}` in BFF logs but not a metric yet. I can add a counter in the Console BFF.

Rafael Mendes: Please do. Separate alert: “empty state due to freshness” so we can distinguish from “no opportunities”.

Jordan Lee: On the incident definition piece: IMO it’s an incident if:
1) We show savings numbers when baseline_age > 24h (misleading), OR
2) We suppress suggestions for >2h due to freshness for multiple beta tenants (feature unusable), OR
3) Any cross-tenant data issue (always incident regardless of beta)

Allison Grant: Agree. For beta, we can treat (2) as SEV-3 unless it’s widespread.

Connor O'Brien: Release note: we’re enabling cohort gradually. Can we have different thresholds pre/post enablement? Early on, volume will be low and alerts might be weird.

Rafael Mendes: Good call. Let’s gate the paging alerts behind `beta_enabled_tenants >= 3` so we don’t page on day 0.

IncidentBot: Reminder: Please link alert definitions + runbook in #eng-sre-oncall-readiness doc before next deploy window.

Logan Wright: Action items on me:
- Add stale_ratio + total volume panels to dashboard
- Proposed alert rules: ticket at >10% stale for 30m (total>100), page at >30% stale for 30m (total>300)
- SEV-2 trigger: any tenant where histogram p95 baseline_age > 24h for 60m AND tenant is in beta allowlist

Dylan Brooks: From product side, can we align the UI behavior with these thresholds? e.g., if baseline_age > 24h then don’t show savings, show “insufficient fresh telemetry”.

Chloe Martin: I can put a UI contract: backend already sends `is_stale` + `baseline_age_hours`. We can add `stale_severity` = `warn|block` so Console doesn’t encode thresholds.

Allison Grant: +1. Keep thresholds server-side so we can adjust without redeploying Console.

Rafael Mendes: Cool. Can someone write the incident rubric in the runbook so oncall doesn’t have to debate at 2am?

Jordan Lee: I’ll add to runbook:
- SEV-2: misleading savings shown with >24h baselines for beta tenant OR any privacy/tenant isolation issue
- SEV-3: stale_ratio >30% for 30m with total>300 across beta cohort OR suggestions blocked due to freshness for >2h in >=3 beta tenants
- Non-incident: isolated stale <10% or <100 total, create ticket + monitor

Mei Lin: Please also add “how to verify” steps (SQL / dashboard link) so Support doesn’t ping SRE for every screenshot.

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: Works for me. Let’s implement metrics + runbook updates today; I want alerts merged before flag goes to 10% cohort.

Allison Grant: (reactions: :thumbsup: x4)

Logan Wright: Will push PR for alert rules + dashboard panels EOD.

Chloe Martin: I’ll add the BFF counter tomorrow morning and wire to dashboard.

Rafael Mendes: Closing loop: once rules are in, I’ll do a test fire in staging and confirm paging route. Thanks all.
